run_waymo_movie: run the script to generate an MP4 movie from a random Waymo scenario file
run_simulation_step: run a simulation step by calling sim.step with a time delta to advance the scenario
create_simulation: create a Simulation instance from a scenario file and configuration dictionary using nocturne
capture_scenario_image: capture a scenario image with specified width, height, and padding using scenario.getImage
set_expert_control: set all vehicles in a scenario to expert control mode by iterating over scenario.getVehicles
